# Vendune

> A source-available Rust ecommerce prototype under the Vendune Sustainable Use License for merchant-approved AI operations,
> local LLMs, partial MCP/UCP adapters and selected original Shopware behavior ports.

## Start
- [Overview](https://sthamann.github.io/vendune/)
- [Measured local performance](https://sthamann.github.io/vendune/benchmarks.html)
- [Local quickstart](https://sthamann.github.io/vendune/quickstart.html)
- [Local MCP bridge](https://sthamann.github.io/vendune/mcp.html)
- [Shopware behavior ports](https://sthamann.github.io/vendune/shopware.html)

- [Connected playground](https://sthamann.github.io/vendune/playground.html)

## Current release
- [Core hardening](https://sthamann.github.io/vendune/docs/core-hardening.html): Eighteen review findings, trusted request identity, explicit API permissions, non-owner forced RLS, transaction-local scoping, real PgBouncer tests, shared resource leases and durable outbox recovery. Deployment cutover and proof boundaries are explicit.
- [8 October release review](https://sthamann.github.io/vendune/docs/current-release.html): Managed Storyfront apps, domains/editor links, channel pause/private previews, guest buyers and merchant enrollment; public/native deployment boundaries.
- [Sales channels and domains](https://sthamann.github.io/vendune/docs/channel-management.html)
- [Currencies and pricing](https://sthamann.github.io/vendune/docs/currencies.html)
- [Rust app services](https://sthamann.github.io/vendune/docs/rust-services.html)

## Limits
Working prototype. The tour uses simulated/manual payments. Configured PayPal Sandbox/Live is supported; actual PSP transactions remain unverified.
Not a full Shopware replacement or validated production SaaS.
MCP/UCP are partial bindings. Hosted merchant/password enrollment and the private Experience service exist; Google/Apple OAuth requires explicit configuration and is not certified by the deployment review.
Experience mounts install a public Storyfront integration, not the private renderer; public native renderer activation remains a separate deployment choice.
Live cloud quality, production scale and causal sales uplift are unverified.

## License
Own-business storefronts are permitted. Commercial shop platforms, managed hosting,
white-label or embedded commerce SaaS for independent merchants need separate written permission.
Previously distributed MIT versions retain their terms. Third-party licenses remain intact.
- [License](https://github.com/sthamann/vendune/blob/main/LICENSE)
- [Usage guide](https://sthamann.github.io/vendune/docs/licensing.html)
